audit_summary: All 11 facts are directly supported by the cited repository files.

facts.statement: The default Python test-file patterns are test_*.py and *_test.py; __init__.py is not a default test-file pattern.

While processing a directory argument, the session visits its descendants and, once per encountered directory, constructs that directory's __init__.py path; if it exists, pytest passes it to _collectfile before processing the directory's other files.

The Python collection hook explicitly treats __init__.py as matching by appending it to the configured python_files patterns, so an existing initializer can produce a collector even when it does not match the configured patterns themselves.
pytest_pycollect_makemodule creates a Package collector whenever the file basename is __init__.py.
Package inherits Module, and Module resolves its underlying object by calling _importtestmodule.
_importtestmodule imports the collector's filesystem path using py.path.local.pyimport; import failures are converted into collection errors.

Package.collect unconditionally mounts the package object before deciding whether its __init__.py should also be yielded as a test Module; yielding that Module remains conditional on __init__.py matching the configured python_files patterns.
Mounting a collector object calls its _getobj implementation when the object has not already been loaded, which connects Package.collect to Module._importtestmodule.
The existing __init__.py collection test intentionally configures python_files = *.py, which includes __init__.py.
The corresponding test asserts that __init__.py is collected as a Module when python_files has been broadened, and separately asserts direct __init__.py argument behavior.

Another existing test records the intended distinction that an __init__.py not matching python_files is not collected as a test module, but it only checks the resulting item count and does not make the initializer fail on import.

scope_summary: Inspected only the supplied repository at base commit e856638ba086fcf5bebf1bebea32d5cf78de87b4. The existing collection pipeline discovers every package initializer beneath a directory argument and imports it while constructing the Package collector, even though the default python_files patterns exclude __init__.py as a test module.
unknowns: No regression test was found in the supplied base-commit tree that places import-failing code in a non-test package __init__.py beneath an ordinary directory invocation.
Repository inspection alone does not establish whether third-party collection or ignore hooks alter this behavior in a particular external project.
